newsitem.title: UK: FTSE 100 starts day weaker, tracking Dow and bunds.
newsitem.headline: FTSE 100 starts day weaker, tracking Dow and bunds.

text.p: The FTSE 100 index of leading UK shares started Thursday's session weaker, hit by uncertainty over European issues and overnight losses on the Dow, dealers and strategists said.
The index was 12.3 points off at 4,665.2 by 0744 GMT, after touching 4,656.3 in opening trade.
The French market fell about four percent on Wednesday, amid rumours that private polls showed the Socialists well-placed for victory in Sunday's election.
Also, after the London market closed, the Bundesbank said it rejected the German government's plan to revalue its gold and currency assets to get into shape for EMU.
